name: ai-advantage
description: Sports betting platform with ML predictions, Kelly sizing, live odds, steam/line-move desk lens, and daily AI picks. NBA, NFL, MLB.

paragraphs: ML-driven sports betting product: predictions, Kelly-based bet sizing, live odds, and a real subscription surface. Live at aiadvantagesports.com.
Most "AI betting" projects stop at a notebook. This one ships.
AI Advantage turns model output into a decision a user can actually act on:
features: Predict — model-driven picks across NBA, NFL, and MLB
Size — Kelly-based stake recommendations that protect bankroll
Time — live odds and line-movement views to catch value before the market adjusts
Monetize — premium tier with real Stripe checkout, not a fake paywall
